title: Design System: BAD FORM Systems — DAYBOOK

display.purpose: Login and console page title (bf-h1). Rare.

headline.purpose: Page titles (bf-h2, desk__title). Desk sizes it at 24·dk; page heads drop to 20px.

title.purpose: Card and panel titles. bf-h3 sub-headings are 13px ink-mute.

body.purpose: Default text; sublines step to 13/12/11px in ink-mute. Glove mode raises body to 16px.

label.purpose: bf-label — sentence-case masthead and field labels. Never uppercase.

mono.purpose: Codes at 600, amounts at 500, right-aligned, tabular-nums.

total.purpose: The single headline figure of a money panel, sized in the Desk unit.

stamp.purpose: The uppercase status atom. The only uppercase text in the system.

kiosk-title.purpose: Kiosk masthead title at arm's length; 20px under 600px. Stage names step up to 32px.

kiosk-label.purpose: KioskButton label over a 14px ink-mute hint.

shadows.name: resting
shadows.value: 0 1px 2px color-mix(in srgb, var(--ink) 4%, transparent), 0 2px 6px color-mix(in srgb, var(--ink) 3%, transparent)
shadows.purpose: Tickets, Desk panels and cards at rest. Felt, not seen.

shadows.name: card-hover-lift
shadows.value: var(--shadow), 0 calc(4 * var(--dk)) calc(12 * var(--dk)) color-mix(in srgb, var(--ink) 4%, transparent)
shadows.purpose: Interactive Desk cards on hover, with border to --rule-strong.

shadows.name: inset-hairline
shadows.purpose: Active nav pill on the desktop masthead.

shadows.name: overlay
shadows.purpose: Sheet scrim. Flat colour, no blur.

shadows.name: segment-selected
shadows.purpose: Selected item of the Field segmented control, lifted on paper-raise inside a paper-sink track with an inset hairline.

shadows.name: ring
shadows.purpose: Unfilled circle marks: stage marks, capture radios, PIN dots. Fill with --mark when done or selected.

motion.name: confirm-ms
motion.purpose: State transitions: border, colour, background, filter, link gap.

units.name: dk
units.purpose: Desk composition unit: 1px at 1280 wide, 1.15px cap. Command Center surfaces and the desktop masthead only; not a global type scale.

themes.name: amber-on-void
themes.purpose: Dark remap of the same roles; --mark becomes #e8c547.

densities.name: thumb
densities.purpose: Field app: one 600px column, 56px bar tabs, full-width verbs.

densities.name: arm
densities.purpose: Workshop kiosk: 96px tiles, 88px PIN keys, two controls per screen.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The one filled verb on a view. --mark fill, --mark-ink text, sentence case.

components.name: Default Button

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: Transparent, rule hairline, muted text. Tertiary actions and quiet masthead controls.
components.css: .ds-btn { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; min-height: var(--tap-min, 44px); padding: 0 16px; border: 1px solid var(--rule-strong, #d4d4d8); border-radius: var(--r, 6px); background: var(--paper-raise, #fff); color: var(--ink, #18181b); font-family: var(--font-ui, 'IBM Plex Sans', sans-serif); font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; cursor: pointer; transition: border-color 140ms; } .ds-btn--ghost { background: transparent; border-color: var(--rule, #e4e4e7); color: var(--ink-mute, #63636b); } .ds-btn--ghost:hover:not(:disabled) { border-color: var(--ink-faint, #8b8b94); } .ds-btn:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--focus, #18181b); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Stamp
components.description: The status atom: 10px uppercase ink stamp tinted 9% of its tone. Never a CTA.
components.html: Chase quote Paid Overdue Live Hold Recall
components.css: .ds-stamp { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; border: 0; border-radius: var(--r-sm, 4px); padding: 3px 8px; font-family: var(--font-ui, 'IBM Plex Sans', sans-serif); font-size: 10px; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.06em; text-transform: uppercase; white-space: nowrap; color: var(--ink-mute, #63636b); background: color-mix(in srgb, currentColor 9%, transparent); margin-right: 6px; } .ds-stamp--ok { color: var(--ok, #2f6b4f); } .ds-stamp--warn { color: var(--warn, #b45309); } .ds-stamp--bad { color: var(--bad, #9b2335); } .ds-stamp--hold { color: var(--hold, #63636b); } .ds-stamp--live { color: var(--live, #1f4d3a); } .ds-stamp--mark { color: var(--stamp-ink, #18181b); background: var(--stamp-paper, #e8c547); }

components.name: Chip
components.description: Filter/toggle chip. Transparent at rest; sinks to paper-sink with an ink border when selected.
components.html: <button class="ds-chip" aria-pressed="false">Glove off</button> <button class="ds-chip" aria-pressed="true">All jobs</button>
components.css: .ds-chip { min-height: var(--tap-min, 44px); padding: 0 12px; border: 1px solid var(--rule, #e4e4e7); border-radius: var(--r, 6px); background: transparent; color: var(--ink-mute, #63636b); font-family: var(--font-ui, 'IBM Plex Sans', sans-serif); font-size: 13px; font-weight: 500; white-space: nowrap; cursor: pointer; margin-right: 6px; transition: border-color 140ms, background-color 140ms; } .ds-chip:hover { border-color: var(--ink-faint, #8b8b94); } .ds-chip[aria-pressed="true"] { background: var(--paper-sink, #f4f4f5); color: var(--ink, #18181b); border-color: var(--ink, #18181b); } .ds-chip:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--focus, #18181b); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: White field on a rule-strong hairline; focus is the global 2px --mark outline.
components.css: .ds-field { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 6px; max-width: 320px; font-family: var(--font-ui, 'IBM Plex Sans', sans-serif); } .ds-label { font-size: 11px; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: 0.02em; color: var(--ink-mute, #63636b); } .ds-input { min-height: var(--tap-min, 44px); padding: 10px 12px; border: 1px solid var(--rule-strong, #d4d4d8); border-radius: var(--r, 6px); background: var(--paper-raise, #fff); color: var(--ink, #18181b); font: inherit; font-size: 14px; caret-color: var(--mark, #18181b); } .ds-input:hover { border-color: var(--ink-faint, #8b8b94); } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--focus, #18181b); outline-offset: 2px; border-radius: var(--r-sm, 4px); }

components.css: .ds-mast { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 14px; min-height: 64px; padding: 8px 24px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--rule, #e4e4e7); background: var(--paper-raise, #fff); font-family: var(--font-ui, 'IBM Plex Sans', sans-serif); } .ds-wordmark { margin: 0; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: -0.02em; white-space: nowrap; color: var(--ink, #18181b); } .ds-mast-stamp { display: inline-flex; padding: 3px 8px; border-radius: var(--r-sm, 4px); font-size: 10px; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.06em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--live, #1f4d3a); background: color-mix(in srgb, currentColor 9%, transparent); } .ds-nav { display: flex; gap: 2px; margin-left: 4px; } .ds-nav a { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; min-height: var(--tap-desk, 32px); padding: 0 10px; border-radius: var(--r-sm, 4px); color: var(--ink-mute, #63636b); text-decoration: none; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 500; white-space: nowrap; transition: color 140ms, background-color 140ms; } .ds-nav a:hover { color: var(--ink, #18181b); } .ds-nav a[aria-current="page"] { color: var(--ink, #18181b); background: var(--paper-sink, #f4f4f5); box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px var(--rule, #e4e4e7); } .ds-nav a:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--focus, #18181b); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-avatar { display: inline-grid; place-items: center; width: 32px; height: 32px; margin-left: auto; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--paper-sink, #f4f4f5); color: var(--ink, #18181b); font-size: 11px; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.02em; }

components.css: .ds-ticket { max-width: 360px; background: var(--paper-raise, #fff); border: 1px solid var(--rule, #e4e4e7); border-radius: var(--r, 6px); padding: 14px 16px; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px color-mix(in srgb, var(--ink, #18181b) 4%, transparent), 0 2px 6px color-mix(in srgb, var(--ink, #18181b) 3%, transparent); font-family: var(--font-ui, 'IBM Plex Sans', sans-serif); color: var(--ink, #18181b); transition: border-color 140ms, box-shadow 140ms; } .ds-ticket:hover { border-color: var(--rule-strong, #d4d4d8); } .ds-ticket__head { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 12px; } .ds-ticket__code { font-family: var(--font-mono, 'IBM Plex Mono', monospace); font-size: 13px; font-weight: 600; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-ticket__stamp { display: inline-flex; padding: 3px 8px; border-radius: var(--r-sm, 4px); font-size: 10px; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.06em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--live, #1f4d3a); background: color-mix(in srgb, currentColor 9%, transparent); } .ds-ticket__title { margin: 4px 0 0; font-size: 15px; font-weight: 500; line-height: 1.3; } .ds-ticket__rule { border: 0; border-top: 1px solid var(--rule, #e4e4e7); margin: 12px 0 8px; } .ds-ticket__row { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: baseline; gap: 12px; } .ds-ticket__sub { font-size: 12px; color: var(--ink-mute, #63636b); } .ds-ticket__amt { font-family: var(--font-mono, 'IBM Plex Mono', monospace); font-size: 13px; font-weight: 500; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; text-align: right; }

components.css: .ds-desk-card { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 40px minmax(0, 1fr) auto; align-items: center; gap: 14px; max-width: 380px; min-height: 96px; padding: 18px 18px 18px 16px; text-decoration: none; color: var(--ink, #18181b); background: var(--paper-raise, #fff); border: 1px solid var(--rule, #e4e4e7); border-radius: var(--r, 6px); box-shadow: 0 1px 2px color-mix(in srgb, var(--ink, #18181b) 4%, transparent), 0 2px 6px color-mix(in srgb, var(--ink, #18181b) 3%, transparent); font-family: var(--font-ui, 'IBM Plex Sans', sans-serif); transition: border-color 140ms, box-shadow 140ms; } .ds-desk-card:hover { border-color: var(--rule-strong, #d4d4d8); box-shadow: 0 1px 2px color-mix(in srgb, var(--ink, #18181b) 4%, transparent), 0 2px 6px color-mix(in srgb, var(--ink, #18181b) 3%, transparent), 0 4px 12px color-mix(in srgb, var(--ink, #18181b) 4%, transparent); } .ds-desk-card:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--focus, #18181b); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-desk-card__icon { display: grid; place-items: center; width: 40px; height: 40px; } .ds-desk-card__title { display: block; font-size: 15px; font-weight: 500; line-height: 1.3; } .ds-desk-card__sub { display: block; margin-top: 4px; font-size: 13px; color: var(--ink-mute, #63636b); line-height: 1.35; } .ds-desk-card__aff { display: inline-flex; color: var(--ink-mute, #63636b); }

padding: 14px 16px 6px; font-family: var(--font-ui, 'IBM Plex Sans', sans-serif); color: var(--ink, #18181b); } .ds-panel__label { margin: 0; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.1em; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-list { margin-top: 14px; padding-top: 10px; border-top: 1px solid var(--rule, #e4e4e7); } .ds-list__head { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: baseline; min-height: 40px; padding: 2px 0; border-top: 1px solid var(--rule, #e4e4e7); } .ds-row:first-of-type { border-top: 0; } .ds-row__dot { display: inline-block; width: 7px; height: 7px; margin-right: 10px; components.css: .ds-state { display: grid; justify-items: center; gap: 6px; max-width: 360px; margin-bottom: 12px; padding: 28px 20px; text-align: center; border-radius: var(--r, 6px); border: 1px dashed var(--rule-strong, #d4d4d8); background: transparent; font-family: var(--font-ui, 'IBM Plex Sans', sans-serif); } .ds-state__icon { display: grid; place-items: center; width: 40px; height: 40px; margin-bottom: 4px; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--paper-sink, #f4f4f5); color: var(--ink-mute, #63636b); } .ds-state__title { margin: 0; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; color: var(--ink, #18181b); } .ds-state__hint { margin: 0; max-width: 34ch; font-size: 13px; line-height: 1.45; color: var(--ink-mute, #63636b); } .ds-state--loading { border: 0; padding: 20px 0; } .ds-state--loading .ds-state__title { color: var(--ink-mute, #63636b); } .ds-skeleton { display: grid; gap: 8px; width: 100%; margin-top: 8px; } .ds-skeleton__row { display: block; height: 56px; border-radius: var(--r, 6px); background: var(--paper-sink, #f4f4f5); } .ds-state--error { border-style: solid; border-color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--bad, #9b2335) 40%, transparent); background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--bad, #9b2335) 5%, transparent); } .ds-state--error .ds-state__title { color: var(--bad, #9b2335); } .ds-state__retry { margin-top: 6px; min-height: var(--tap-desk, 32px); padding: 0 12px; border: 1px solid var(--rule-strong, #d4d4d8); border-radius: var(--r-sm, 4px); background: var(--paper-raise, #fff); color: var(--ink, #18181b); font: inherit; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 500; cursor: pointer; transition: border-color 140ms; } .ds-state__retry:hover { border-color: var(--ink-faint, #8b8b94); }

components.css: .ds-kiosk { display: grid; grid-template-columns: auto minmax(0, 1fr) auto; align-items: center; gap: 16px; width: 100%; max-width: 640px; min-height: 96px; margin-bottom: 10px; padding: 18px 16px 18px 20px; text-align: left; border: 1px solid var(--rule-strong, #d4d4d8); border-radius: var(--r, 6px); background: var(--paper-raise, #fff); color: var(--ink, #18181b); font-family: var(--font-ui, 'IBM Plex Sans', sans-serif); cursor: pointer; transition: filter 140ms, border-color 140ms; } .ds-kiosk:hover:not(:disabled) { border-color: var(--ink-faint, #8b8b94); } .ds-kiosk:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--focus, #18181b); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-kiosk:disabled { opacity: 0.45; cursor: not-allowed; } .ds-kiosk__icon { display: grid; place-items: center; width: 48px; height: 48px; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--paper-sink, #f4f4f5); color: var(--ink, #18181b); } .ds-kiosk__text { display: grid; gap: 4px; min-width: 0; } .ds-kiosk__label { font-size: 22px; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: -0.02em; line-height: 1.2; } .ds-kiosk__hint { font-size: 14px; color: var(--ink-mute, #63636b); overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; white-space: nowrap; } .ds-kiosk__go { display: grid; color: var(--ink-faint, #8b8b94); } .ds-kiosk--mark { background: var(--mark, #18181b); color: var(--mark-ink, #fff); border-color: var(--mark, #18181b); } .ds-kiosk--mark:hover:not(:disabled) { border-color: var(--mark, #18181b); filter: brightness(1.12); } .ds-kiosk--mark .ds-kiosk__icon { background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--mark-ink, #fff) 14%, transparent); color: var(--mark-ink, #fff); } .ds-kiosk--mark .ds-kiosk__hint { color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--mark-ink, #fff) 72%, transparent); } .ds-kiosk--mark .ds-kiosk__go { color: var(--mark-ink, #fff); }

narrative.overview:
DAYBOOK is the paper-and-ink desk of a yard office, not a software dashboard. The ground is warm off-white paper; work sits on white surfaces separated by whisper hairlines; text is near-black ink; every figure is set in tabular monospace so columns of money line up like a printed ledger. Personality comes from restraint and from two atoms: the ticket (one chit anatomy for jobs, dockets, quotes) and the stamp (statuses as small uppercase ink stamps). Nothing else is allowed to shout.

Colour is almost entirely structural. The one accent slot, --mark, is ink by default and carries the primary verb, the active nav marker, the column dots, the meter fill and the column links. A client instance retints --mark from the Foundry and every accented atom repaints at once; that is the client's identity, not ours. Stamp yellow exists but is a status mark only. Two alternate themes (amber-on-void, paper-docket) remap the same token names, so screens compose against roles, never against values.

Density runs at three distances on the same tokens. Office desk: 14px body, 32px desk-height controls, 44px minimum on anything a gloved hand touches. Thumb (Field app on a phone): one column, 56px bar tabs, 60–72px rows, every verb full width. Arm's length (workshop kiosk on a bolted-down tablet): 96px tiles, 88px PIN keys, 22–32px labels, two controls per screen at most. Motion only confirms an action and finishes inside 150ms. Rejected outright by the shipped build: gradients, glass, blur, purple-on-dark SaaS defaults, ALL-CAPS chrome, yellow verbs, a logo glyph (the wordmark is set in type).
keyCharacteristics: Paper-light neutrals, ink text, 1px low-contrast hairlines as the primary structure.
One accent slot (--mark) bound to the primary verb and active state; retintable in one place.
Two faces only: IBM Plex Sans for UI, IBM Plex Mono for codes and money, always tabular.
Sentence-case chrome; stamps are the only uppercase element.
Flat surfaces with a near-invisible resting shadow; depth from tonal paper steps.
Confirm-only motion, ≤150ms; glove mode scales taps, padding and contrast via tokens.
Three densities (desk, thumb, arm's length) from one token set; the paper-sink circular icon well and the drawn 1.5-stroke icon carry across all three.
One state-panel language for loading, empty and error on every screen.

rules.name: The One Slot Rule
rules.body: Every accented atom — primary verb, active nav, dots, meter, column links, focus ring — reads --mark. No second accent token exists; a client retint must repaint them all with one value.

rules.name: The Status-Only Yellow Rule
rules.body: --stamp-paper colours a stamp and nothing else. Never a button, never nav fill, never brand.

rules.name: The Tinted-Stamp Rule
rules.body: Semantic colours appear as stamp text over a 9% self-tint or as a 7px dot. They never fill a surface, border a card, or colour running text.

rules.name: The Tabular Figure Rule
rules.body: Every number that can be compared to another — money, counts, codes — is set in IBM Plex Mono with font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums, right-aligned when in a column.

rules.name: The Sentence-Case Chrome Rule
rules.body: Nav, buttons, titles and field labels are sentence case with zero tracking. Stamps are the only uppercase element in the system.

rules.name: The Two Faces Rule
rules.body: IBM Plex Sans and IBM Plex Mono. No third family, no system display face, no weight above 600.

rules.name: The Whisper Hairline Rule
rules.body: Structure is drawn with 1px --rule lines and paper steps before it is ever drawn with shadow. A shadow may lift a surface by a hair; it may never separate it.

rules.name: The Confirm-Only Motion Rule
rules.body: Transitions run --confirm-ms (140ms) for state changes and --sheet-ms (180ms) for sheets, easing cubic-bezier(0.2, 0.8, 0.2, 1) where specified. Motion confirms an action; nothing loops, floats or decorates.

dos: Do compose every surface from tokens: --paper/--paper-raise/--paper-sink for ground, --rule for structure, --ink/--ink-mute for text. No literal colour, radius or shadow in a component.
Do bind every accented atom to --mark (The One Slot Rule) so a Foundry retint repaints the verb, active nav, dots, meter and links together.
Do set every code, count and dollar figure in IBM Plex Mono with tabular-nums, right-aligned in columns.
Do keep chrome sentence case with zero tracking; put status in a Stamp and let the Stamp be the only uppercase element.
Do honour --tap-min (44px) on any hand-touched control and --tap-desk (32px) for dense office controls; let glove mode scale them via tokens.
Do draw structure with 1px --rule hairlines and paper steps; use the resting shadow only to lift a ticket a hair.

Do design the empty, loading and error state of every screen with the shared state panel (LoadingView / EmptyView / ErrorView): dashed empty, 5% bad-tinted error, skeleton rows for loading. The Desk's desk-empty and desk-notice are the same language.
Do hold a line icon in a paper-sink circular well (36–72px by distance) when it leads a row, tile or state; on a --mark surface the well is 14% mark-ink.
Do size by distance, not by device: desk 32/44px, thumb 44–72px full-width verbs in one 600px column, arm's length 88–96px tiles with two controls per screen.
Do keep motion to --confirm-ms (140ms) / --sheet-ms (180ms) and only in response to an action.
donts: Don't use --stamp-paper yellow as a button fill, nav fill, or brand colour; it marks status only.
Don't add gradients, glassmorphism, blur overlays, or purple-on-dark defaults; the sheet scrim is flat 32% ink.
Don't set nav, buttons, titles or field labels in ALL CAPS or with letter-spacing; the Desk column labels are Desk-scoped list labels, not a licence for kickers or eyebrows.
Don't introduce a third typeface, a system display face, or weights above 600.
Don't fill a surface, border a card or colour running text with --ok/--warn/--bad/--live; they live in stamps and 7px dots.
Don't add a logo glyph beside the wordmark; the trading name set in IBM Plex Sans is the mark.
Don't use --dk outside Command Center composition (Desk, desktop masthead, content padding); shared components keep fixed pixel tokens.
Don't use emoji, stock illustration, icon fonts or decorative animation in product UI.
Don't shrink the desk screen onto a phone or tile it into a dashboard; Field is one column read top to bottom and Kiosk shows at most two verbs.
Don't put more than three tabs in the Field bottom bar or add a fourth chrome row; Today, Glove and Sign out are the slots.
